description: This Java source file defines a handler class RequireVoidReasonSaveHandler that enforces the presence of a non-empty void reason for voided objects (Patients and Encounters) within the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It implements validation logic to ensure data integrity when saving voided objects.

classes.name: RequireVoidReasonSaveHandler
classes.description: A handler class that validates the presence of a void reason when a voided object is saved, supporting Patient and Encounter objects.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Performs validation to ensure that voided objects have a non-blank void reason; throws APIException if validation fails.
